title: 3D Pointed Dripstone for Frostiful
body:
This is a resource pack to make your ice blocks from the Frostiful mod 3D!

I want to emphasize that this mod would never have been made without [UnduGT](https://modrinth.com/user/UnduGT). All credit goes to that person for this [pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/undopia-3d-pointed-dripstone) !

This pack is useless without the [mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/frostiful) !
